meta.name: project-structure-governance
meta.description: Enforce a clean project-activity contract for any repository the agent works on: coherent project structure, no root clutter, temporary/test/debug scripts isolated in a dedicated workspace, one canonical documentation/runbook entrypoint, and a clear cleanup/checklist before handoff. Use during init, planning, implementation, QA, review, release, documentation sync, scaffolding, migrations, and any task that creates files, scripts, docs, runbooks, examples, fixtures, screenshots, or experiments.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理仓库结构,隔离临时脚本,统一文档入口
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为混乱的项目结构困扰,希望在开发全程都能保持规范。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your repository tidy: organize structure, isolate temp scripts, unify docs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often deal with messy project structures and want clean organization throughout development.

howto.what: 它会先检查项目的现有结构和根目录，把临时、调试、测试文件隔离到专用工作区，确保根目录只留必要文件，并维护一个唯一的文档/运行手册入口，交接前还会检查清理清单。
howto.when: 当任务处于初始化、规划、实现等阶段，或需要创建文件、脚本、文档等产物时触发。

say.text: 检查根目录，把临时脚本移到专用工作区
say.note: 他会按契约整理并汇报

say.text: 统一文档入口，更新运行手册
say.note: 避免重复文档误导后续阅读

say.text: 交接前做一次根目录清理检查

howto.what_en: It will inspect repo structure and root, isolate temp/debug/test files into a dedicated workspace, keep root clean, maintain a single documentation/runbook entrypoint, and check cleanup before handoff.
howto.when_en: Triggers during init, planning, implementation stages, or any task creating files, scripts, docs, or similar artifacts.

say_en.text: Check the root directory; move temp scripts to the dedicated workspace.
say_en.note: It will organize per contract and report.

say_en.text: Consolidate documentation entrypoint and update the runbook.
say_en.note: Prevents duplicate docs misleading later readers.

say_en.text: Do a root cleanup check before handoff.
say_en.note: It lists cleanup items and confirms.
